data.long_meaning: The meaning of Ioab is recorded in name-lists as “God is my father”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ioab expresses “God is my father”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ioab total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

biblical_reference.note: Ioab was a commander in King David's army and later became the king's chief minister. He was the father of Mephibosheth, who was spared by King David's kindness when he could have put him to death.
